Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted to Dedicated — Rightsize Sanity & Contingency Plan

Hi Julie—

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. Per our conversation, attached is a compact rightsizing spreadsheet with two validated configurations for your peak profile and a proposed rehearsal/cutover cadence. High-level summary:

- Suggested primary configuration: 16x A100 80GB-equivalent (sharded across 4 pods) to meet 95th percentile latency <= 220ms and sustained throughput for your 1.2M monthly tokens forecast.
- Cost-optimized fallback: 12x A100-equivalent (3 pods) with aggressive prefix caching enabled; estimated 15% higher p99 latency at peak but ~22% lower monthly infra cost.
- KV cache and continuous batching assumptions are included in the spreadsheet; we modeled your 350 concurrent sessions median and 820 concurrent sessions 95th.

What we need from your side to finalize the reserved capacity commitment:
1) Confirm the 95th concurrent sessions number (we used 820).
2) Approve a two-hour rehearsal window in the week prior to swap for a staged traffic cut (we propose 09:00–11:00 PT on Tue, Sep 7). I attached an .ics for the rehearsal.
3) Any procurement constraints on SLA exceptions (I've attached the draft exceptions page we discussed).

If you confirm (1)-(3) we'll lock in the commit sizing, schedule the rehearsal, and provision staging capacity for an end-to-end smoke run.

Best,
Michael

--

Michael —

Thanks for the clear breakdown. A couple clarifying items before we sign the sizing: 

1) 95th concurrent sessions: 820 is our recent spike recorded in July, but August CFR shows a tail up to ~930 for short bursts. Can you re-run the 95th projection with 930 and show delta to cost/latency?
2) For the fallback config: what's the expected degradation for long-context (>2k tokens) generation? Our product uses ~2.5k median context on some user journeys.
3) Procurement: procurement@bluehorizon.ai copied — they'll need the SLA exceptions doc with a one-pager summary for legal.

Also, Tue Sep 7 09:00–11:00 PT is OK for the rehearsal but we need a morning backup on Sep 9 in case of conflicts.

Thanks,
Julie

Subject: Hosted to Dedicated — Final rightsizing + rehearsal confirmed

Julie/Samir/procurement team —

Appreciate the quick turn. Short summary of finalized items after re-run with 95th concurrency = 930 (attached updated spreadsheet):

- Final primary capacity: 18x A100-equivalent (4 pods, 4/5 sharding) to hold p95 latency <= 230ms under 930 concurrency and 2.5k token median (we simulated long-context paths).
- Fallback: 12x A100-equivalent (3 pods) with prefix/KV cache tuning; expected p95 latency delta +28% on long-context scenarios. We documented mitigations (dynamic reroute to hosted API for specific endpoints, degraded beam width).
- Rehearsal windows: Primary: Tue Sep 7 09:00–11:00 PT. Backup: Thu Sep 9 09:00–11:00 PT. I attached the updated .ics and the rightsizing spreadsheet (BH-4392-rightsizing-breakdown.xlsx).
- Procurement one-pager: attached SLA exceptions summary (bh-procurement-sla-exceptions-draft.pdf).

Next operational steps we will take once you sign:
1) Provision staging capacity and run an end-to-end smoke test (we'll share a test script).
2) Run the rehearsal with staged traffic and measure regressions; we will capture token-level latency heatmaps and KV cache hit-rates.
3) Execute cutover during the approved window and monitor.

Please reply with a short approval ("approve sizing and rehearsal") and we'll push the scheduling invites and provisioning.

Best,
Michael
